# GFP Analysis
## Load Data
```{r}
#Load and clean up GFP
gfp2 <- read.csv("data/DDS 397 GFP cell detection_redux_nowhite.csv") #Reduced GFP cell counts for all mice
View(gfp2)
```

## Clean-Up Data
```{r}
rownames(Mouse_Info) <- Mouse_Info$name
Mouse_Info <- Mouse_Info %>% mutate(Fluid = str_replace(Fluid, "0", "O"))

gfp_sqrt <- gfp2 %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), sqrt))
gfp_sqrt <- gfp_sqrt %>% column_to_rownames(var="name") #changes region labels to row name
View(gfp_sqrt)

Mouse_Info <- Mouse_Info %>% mutate(
  gfp_name = paste0("X", name )) #clean-up to make names consistent 
View(Mouse_Info)

reorder_columns <- match(Mouse_Info$gfp_name, colnames(gfp_sqrt))
gfp_sqrt <- gfp_sqrt[, reorder_columns]

#Now things are in the same order
Mouse_Info$gfp_name == colnames(gfp_sqrt)

colnames(gfp_sqrt) <- Mouse_Info$name 

#Make list of only mice with bilateral NAc viral expression
Info_Bilateral <- Mouse_Info %>% filter(Viral_Placement=="Bilateral") %>% pull(name)
Info_Bilateral <- Info_Bilateral %>% as.character(Info_Bilateral)
Bilateral_sqrt <- gfp_sqrt %>% select(all_of(Info_Bilateral))

# Files to export as supplemental tables S21 & S22
gfp2 <- gfp2 %>% column_to_rownames(var="name")
gfp2 <- gfp2[, reorder_columns]
colnames(gfp2) <- Mouse_Info$Info_Name

Info_Bilateral2 <- Mouse_Info %>% filter(Viral_Placement=="Bilateral") %>% pull(Info_Name)
Info_Bilateral2 <- Info_Bilateral2 %>% as.character(Info_Bilateral2)
gfp_density_raw <- gfp2 %>% select(all_of(Info_Bilateral2))
View(gfp_density_raw)
# write.csv(gfp_density_raw,"/Users/chanamy/Documents/Ozburn Lab/DDS 397 c-Fos circuitry/paper drafts//gfp_density_raw.csv") 

gfp_density_sqrt <- gfp_density_raw %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), sqrt))
View(gfp_density_sqrt)
# write.csv(gfp_density_sqrt,"/Users/chanamy/Documents/Ozburn Lab/DDS 397 c-Fos circuitry/paper drafts//gfp_density_sqrt.csv") 
```

## Supplemental Figure 2H&I - Is GFP density different between sex and fluid groups?
```{r}
View(Bilateral_sqrt)
View(Bi_Info)

tmp <- as.data.frame(t(Bilateral_sqrt))

tmp2 <- data.frame(tmp$`left Nucleus accumbens`,
                   tmp$`right Nucleus accumbens`,
                   Bi_Info$SxFluid,
                   Bi_Info$Sex,
                   Bi_Info$Fluid)
View(tmp2)

tmp2 <- tmp2 %>% mutate(total_NAc = tmp..left.Nucleus.accumbens.+tmp..right.Nucleus.accumbens.) #Total NAc is sum of NAc GFP in the left and right hemisphere 

rstatix::anova_test(total_NAc ~ Bi_Info.SxFluid, 
                    data = tmp2, 
                    type = 3)
#Total NAc GFP density does not differ between sex and fluid groups 

rstatix::anova_test(tmp..left.Nucleus.accumbens. ~ Bi_Info.SxFluid, 
                    data = tmp2, 
                    type = 3)
#Left NAc GFP density does not differ between sex and fluid groups 

rstatix::anova_test(tmp..right.Nucleus.accumbens. ~ Bi_Info.SxFluid, 
                    data = tmp2, 
                    type = 3)
#Right NAc GFP density does not differ between sex and fluid groups

#Supplemental Figure 2H
GFP_sxfluid <- ggbetweenstats(data = tmp2, 
               x="Bi_Info.SxFluid", 
               y="total_NAc", 
               title = "GFP by Sex and Fluid group",
               ylab ="NAc GFP density (cells/mm3)",
               xlab = "Sex+Fluid Groups",
               results.subtitle = FALSE,
               outlier.tagging = TRUE,
               outlier.coef = 1.5,
               outlier.label = name) + 
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = c("#C87A8A", "#9189C7","#909646", "#00A396")) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 110), 
    breaks = seq(from = 0, to = 100, by = 20))

GFP_sxfluid

ggsave("GFP_sxfluid.svg", 
       width = 8, 
       height = 6, 
       units = "in")

# Is variance different between sex and fluid groups?
lapply(split(tmp2, tmp2$Bi_Info.Sex), function(x) {bartlett.test(total_NAc ~ Bi_Info.Fluid, data = x)})
#Neither Male or Female ethanol and water significantly different variances

lapply(split(tmp2, tmp2$Bi_Info.Fluid), function(x) {bartlett.test(total_NAc ~ Bi_Info.Sex, data = x)}) #Water and ethanol groups are not significantly different from each other (between sexes)

test <- split(tmp2, tmp2$Bi_Info.SxFluid)
View(test)
test_1 <- full_join(test$FxEtOH, test$MxH2O)
View(test_1)
bartlett.test(total_NAc ~ Bi_Info.Sex, data = test_1) #Female ethanol not different than male water

test_2 <- full_join(test$MxEtOH, test$FxH2O) 
View(test_2)
bartlett.test(total_NAc ~ Bi_Info.Sex, data = test_2) #Male ethanol not different than female water

#Are there group differences in total GFP expression?
tmp3 <- as.data.frame(tmp) %>% mutate(GFP_Sum = rowSums(tmp), #Calculate total c-Fos density for each mouse
  SxFluid = Bi_Info$SxFluid, 
  Sex = Bi_Info$Sex, 
  Fluid = Bi_Info$Fluid)
View(tmp3)

rstatix::anova_test(GFP_Sum ~ SxFluid, 
                    data = tmp3, 
                    type = 3) #No effect of sex or fluid on total brain GFP expression

#Supplemental Figure 2I
GFP_sxfluid2 <- ggbetweenstats(data = tmp3, 
               x="SxFluid", 
               y="GFP_Sum", 
               title = "Total GFP by Sex and Fluid group",
               ylab ="Total GFP density (cells/mm3)",
               xlab = "Sex+Fluid Groups",
               results.subtitle = FALSE,
               outlier.tagging = TRUE,
               outlier.coef = 1.5,
               outlier.label = name) + 
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = c("#C87A8A", "#9189C7","#909646", "#00A396")) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 16000), 
    breaks = seq(from = 0, to = 15000, by = 1500))

GFP_sxfluid2

ggsave("GFP_sxfluid2.svg", 
       width = 8, 
       height = 6, 
       units = "in")

# Is variance different between sex and fluid groups?
lapply(split(tmp3, tmp3$Sex), function(x) {bartlett.test(GFP_Sum ~ Fluid, data = x)})
#Neither Male or Female ethanol and water significantly different variances

lapply(split(tmp3, tmp3$Fluid), function(x) {bartlett.test(GFP_Sum ~ Sex, data = x)}) #Water and ethanol groups are not significantly different from each other (between sexes)

test <- split(tmp3, tmp3$SxFluid)
View(test)
test_1 <- full_join(test$F_EtOH, test$M_H2O)
View(test_1)
bartlett.test(GFP_Sum ~ Sex, data = test_1) #Female ethanol not different than male water

test_2 <- full_join(test$M_EtOH, test$F_H2O) 
View(test_2)
bartlett.test(GFP_Sum ~ Sex, data = test_2) #Male ethanol not different than female water
```

# c-Fos + GFP Colocalization Analysis
## Load Data
```{r}
#c-Fos+GFP colocalization density
cFos_gfp <- read.csv("data/DDS 397 cFos+GFP cell DENSITY_redux_nowhite.csv")
View(cFos_gfp)
```

##Clean-Up Data
```{r}
cFos_gfp <- cFos_gfp %>% column_to_rownames(var="name")
colnames(cFos_gfp) <- str_replace(colnames(cFos_gfp),"X","")

#Mouse names are consistent but not in the same order
Mouse_Info$Name == colnames(cFos_gfp) 

#Match returns the position of entries of the first vector in the second. This will give us the order of columns in the cFos data to match ordering in the Mouse_Info
reorder_columns <- match(Mouse_Info$name, colnames(cFos_gfp))
cFos_gfp <- cFos_gfp[, reorder_columns]

#Now things are in the same order
Mouse_Info$name == colnames(cFos_gfp)
View(cFos_gfp)

# Files to export as supplemental tables S23 & S24
cFos_gfp2 <- cFos_gfp 
colnames(cFos_gfp2) <- Mouse_Info$Info_Name
View(cFos_gfp2)

cFos_gfp_density_raw <- cFos_gfp2 %>% select(all_of(Info_Bilateral2))
View(cFos_gfp_density_raw)
#write.csv(cFos_gfp_density_raw,"/Users/chanamy/Documents/Ozburn Lab/DDS 397 c-Fos circuitry/paper drafts//cFos_gfp_density_raw.csv") 

cFos_gfp_density_sqrt <- cFos_gfp_density_raw %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), sqrt))
View(cFos_gfp_density_sqrt)
#write.csv(cFos_gfp_density_sqrt,"/Users/chanamy/Documents/Ozburn Lab/DDS 397 c-Fos circuitry/paper drafts//cFos_gfp_density_sqrt.csv")
```

## Split Data by viral placement
```{r}
Bilateral <- cFos_gfp %>% select(all_of(Info_Bilateral))

Bi_Info <- Mouse_Info %>% filter(Viral_Placement=="Bilateral")
rownames(Bi_Info) <- Bi_Info$name
View(Bi_Info)
```

### Supplemental Figure S3D
Is c-Fos+GFP colocalization different between hemispheres?
```{r}
cfos_gfp_Bi <- Bilateral_sqrt %>%
	group_by(Region_Info$Hemisphere) %>%
	summarize(across(everything(), list(mean = mean, sum = sum)))
View(cfos_gfp_Bi)

cfos_gfp_Bi <- pivot_longer(ungroup(cfos_gfp_Bi), 2:83, 
                            names_to = c("sample","operation"), 
                            names_sep = "_",
                            values_to = "value") #Change numbers of columns when you have the final data set
View(cfos_gfp_Bi)

cfos_gfp_Bi %>% group_by(cfos_gfp_Bi$`Region_Info$Hemisphere`) %>% 
  filter(operation == "sum") %>% 
  summarise(sum(value)) 

cFos_gfp_hemi <- ggbetweenstats(cfos_gfp_Bi %>% filter(operation == "sum"), 
               x=`Region_Info$Hemisphere`, 
               y=value, 
               xlab = "Hemisphere",
               ylab ="c-Fos+GFP colocalization (cells/mm^3)",
               results.subtitle = FALSE,
               title = "Bilateral c-Fos+GFP")

ggsave("cFos_gfp_hemi.svg", 
       width = 8, 
       height = 6, 
       units = "in")
```

## Figure 2A, Supplemental Table S3 - differential expression
Ethanol vs Water (sex collapsed)
```{r}
#Ethanol vs Water (sex collapsed)
W #All Water drinkers
E #All Ethanol drinkers

pval_all <- double(nrow(W)) 
for(n in 1:nrow(W)) {pval_all[n] <- t.test(x = W[n, ], y = E[n, ])$p.val} #calculated p-value comparing all water and ethanol groups, which are stored in 2 separate data frames. 
View(pval_all)

VP_Bi_Fos_GFP <- data.frame(lfc = log2(rowMeans(E)+1) - log2(rowMeans(W)+1),
                          pval = -log10(pval_all),
                          region = rownames(Bilateral_sqrt)) #Add 1 to log expressions to prevent infinities
View(VP_Bi_Fos_GFP)

#Plot colored by p-val and direction of lfc
VP_Bi_Fos_GFP <- VP_Bi_Fos_GFP %>% mutate(hsig = if_else(abs(pval) > 1.3, 2 , 0),
	dir = sign(lfc),
	color = hsig*dir,
	color = factor(color))
view(VP_Bi_Fos_GFP) #color value assigned to regions with -log(pval)>1.3

tmp_scatter9 <- ggscatter(VP_Bi_Fos_GFP, 
                          x="lfc", 
                          y="pval", 
                          color="color", 
          title = "c-Fos+GFP - Ethanol vs. Water", 
          xlab = "log fold change", 
          ylab = "-log10(p-value)",
  palette = c("blue","gray","red")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept=1.3, linetype = "dashed") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0) + 
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-4,4),
                    breaks = seq(-4,4,1)) +
  ylim(0, 3)

tmp_scatter9

ggsave("VP_cfos_gfp_EtOHvH2O.svg",
       width = 6, 
       height = 4, 
       units = "in")

#Regions with p.val >1.3 and lfc >0 (higher expression in ethanol drinking mice)
ztest <- data.frame(region = VP_Bi_Fos_GFP %>%
	filter(color == 2 ) %>%
	pull(region), 
	pval = VP_Bi_Fos_GFP %>%
	filter(color == 2 ) %>%
	pull(pval),
  lfc = VP_Bi_Fos_GFP %>%
	filter(color == 2 ) %>%
	pull(lfc)) 
view(ztest)

#Regions with p.val >1.3 and lfc <0 (higher expression in water drinking mice)
z1test <- data.frame(region = VP_Bi_Fos_GFP %>%
	filter(color == -2 ) %>%
	pull(region), 
	pval = VP_Bi_Fos_GFP %>%
	filter(color == -2 ) %>%
	pull(pval),
```

```{r}
#Create a function to plot each region
cat_chart1 <- function(data, region){

  test <- data %>% 
    filter(Region == region)

  plot1 <- ggboxplot(test, 
                     x="sex_stain", 
                     y="density", 
                     color = "sex", 
                     palette=c("#C87A8A","#909646"), 
                     title = region, 
                     xlab = "", 
                     ylab = "density (cells/mm^3)", 
                     legend = "none") + 
    geom_jitter(color="black", size=0.4, alpha=0.9) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 110), 
    breaks = seq(from = 0, to = 100, by = 20)) + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, angle = 90),
  axis.title.y = element_text(size = 8), 
  axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8), 
  title = element_text(size = 8)
  )

  return(plot1)
}
```

#c-Fos
## Clean-Up Data
```{r}
Mouse_Info$Old_name %in% 	colnames(cFos_density_redux)
colnames(cFos_density_redux) <- str_replace(colnames(cFos_density_redux),"H20","H2O") #Change typo in H2O

cFos_density_redux <- cFos_density_redux %>% column_to_rownames(var="name") #Changes region labels to row name

#Mouse names are consistent but not in the same order
Mouse_Info$Old_name %in% colnames(cFos_density_redux) 

#Match returns the position of entries of the first vector in the second. This will give us the order of columns in the cFos data to match ordering in the Mouse_Info
reorder_columns <- match(Mouse_Info$Old_name, colnames(cFos_density_redux))
cFos_density_redux <- cFos_density_redux[, reorder_columns]

#Now things are in the same order
Mouse_Info$Old_name == colnames(cFos_density_redux)

colnames(cFos_density_redux) <- Mouse_Info$name #Changes to shortened name that matches Mouse_Info dataframe
Mouse_Info$name %in% colnames(cFos_density_redux) #Check if names are consistent between dataframes
View(cFos_density_redux)

# Files to export as supplemental tables 19&20
cFos_density_raw <- cFos_density_redux
colnames(cFos_density_raw) <- Mouse_Info$Info_Name
View(cFos_density_raw)
#write.csv(cFos_density_raw,"/Users/chanamy/Documents/Ozburn Lab/DDS 397 c-Fos circuitry/paper drafts//cFos_density_raw.csv") 

cFos_density_sqrt <- cFos_density_raw %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), sqrt))
View(cFos_density_sqrt)
```

```{r}
               y="cFos_Sum", 
               title = "c-Fos by Sex and Fluid group",
               ylab ="Sum of c-Fos density (cells/mm3)",
               xlab = "Sex+Fluid Groups",
               results.subtitle = FALSE,
               outlier.tagging = TRUE,
               outlier.coef = 1.5,
               outlier.label = name) + 
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 30000), 
    breaks = seq(from = 0, to = 30000, by = 10000)) +
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = c("#C87A8A", "#9189C7","#909646", "#00A396"))

cFos_sxfluid

ggsave("cFos_sxfluid.svg", 
       width = 8, 
       height = 6, 
       units = "in")

# Is variance different between sex and fluid groups?
lapply(split(tmp, tmp$Sex), function(x) {bartlett.test(cFos_Sum ~ Fluid, data = x)})
#Male ethanol and water have significantly different variances

lapply(split(tmp, tmp$Fluid), function(x) {bartlett.test(cFos_Sum ~ Sex, data = x)}) #Water and ethanol grous are not significantly different from each other (between sexes)

test <- split(tmp, tmp$SxFluid)
test_1 <- full_join(test$F_EtOH, test$M_H2O)
View(test_1)
bartlett.test(cFos_Sum ~ Sex, data = test_1) #Female ethanol not different than male water

test_2 <- full_join(test$M_EtOH, test$F_H2O) 
View(test_2)
bartlett.test(cFos_Sum ~ Sex, data = test_2) #Male ethanol not different than female water

#male water fdr correction 
p.adjust(c(0.02189, 0.06131, 0.05702), method = "fdr") #none significant

#Are any mice outliers?
boxplot(tmp$cFos_Sum, col = "blue",
  ylab = "Sum of c-Fos density (cells/mm3)")
#No outliers identified from the boxplot

lower_bound <- quantile(tmp$cFos_Sum, 0.025)
upper_bound <- quantile(tmp$cFos_Sum, 0.975)
outlier_ind <- which(tmp$cFos_Sum < lower_bound | tmp$cFos_Sum > upper_bound)
outlier_ind
# 4 mice are outside the 95% percentile bounds: 8,44,120, (all male water), 143 (female water)

#Hampel filter - outliers are >3 median standard deviations
lower_bound <- median(tmp$cFos_Sum) - 3 * mad(tmp$cFos_Sum, constant = 1)
upper_bound <- median(tmp$cFos_Sum) + 3 * mad(tmp$cFos_Sum, constant = 1)
outlier_ind <- which(tmp$cFos_Sum < lower_bound | tmp$cFos_Sum > upper_bound)
outlier_ind
#2 mice are outside the Hampel filter, 44 and 120
```

## Figure 3B, Supplemental Table S5 
Compare c-Fos differential expression between water drinking mice 
```{r}
MWa #Male water drinkers
FWa #Female water drinkers 

pval_water <- double(nrow(MWa)) 
for(n in 1:nrow(MWa)) {pval_water[n] <- t.test(x = MWa[n, ], y = FWa[n, ])$p.val} #calculated p-value comparing male and female water groups c-Fos density

MAplotData_397_water <- data.frame(lfc = log2(rowMeans(FWa)+1) - log2(rowMeans(MWa)+1),
                           pval = -log10(pval_water),
                           region = rownames(cFos_397_redux_SQRT)) #Add 1 to log expressions to prevent infinities
View(MAplotData_397_water) #Dataframe comparing c-Fos expression between male and female water drinking mice

#Volcano plot colored by p-val
MAplotData_397_water1 <- MAplotData_397_water %>% mutate(hsig = if_else(abs(pval) > 1.3, 2 , 0),
	dir = sign(lfc),
	color = hsig*dir,
	color = factor(color))
View(MAplotData_397_water1) #color value assigned to regions with -log(pval)>1.3

                          x="lfc", 
                          y="pval", 
                          color="color", 
          title = "Water Male vs. Female", 
          xlab = "log fold change", 
          ylab = "-log10(p-value)",
  palette = c("blue","gray","red")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept=1.3, linetype = "dashed") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0) +
  xlim(-1.0, 1.15) + 
  ylim(0, 5)

tmp_scatter1

ggsave("VP_Water_MvF.svg",
       width = 6, 
       height = 4, 
       units = "in")

	filter(color == 2) %>%
	pull(pval),
  lfc = MAplotData_397_water1 %>%
	filter(color == 2) %>%
	pull(lfc)) 
View(vtest)

#Regions with p.val >1.3 and lfc <0 (higher expression in male water mice)

	filter(color == -2) %>%

	pull(lfc)) 
View(v1test)
```

# Network Analysis: Method 1 - Correlation Matrix Networks
## Figure 4A, Male water - Correlations heatmaps & clusters 
```{r}
#MWa - male water drinkers only
View(MWa)

MWa_trans <- MWa %>% t()
#view(MWa_trans)
MWa_per_corr <- cor(MWa_trans, method = "pearson")
View(MWa_per_corr)

MWa_hclust_avg <- hclust(1 - as.dist(MWa_per_corr), method = 'average')

MWa_hvk <- data.frame(cluster_30 = cutree(MWa_hclust_avg, h=.30), 
                      cluster_40 = cutree(MWa_hclust_avg, h=.40), 
                      cluster_50 = cutree(MWa_hclust_avg, h=.50),
                      cluster_60 = cutree(MWa_hclust_avg, h=.60),
                      cluster_66 = cutree(MWa_hclust_avg, h=.66),
                      cluster_70 = cutree(MWa_hclust_avg, h=.70),
                      cluster_75 = cutree(MWa_hclust_avg, h=.75),
                      cluster_80 = cutree(MWa_hclust_avg, h=.80),
                      cluster_90 = cutree(MWa_hclust_avg, h=.90))
View(MWa_hvk) #Data used in Prism to generate Figure 3I

corrplot(MWa_per_corr, 
         type = "full", 
         tl.pos = "n",
         method = "color", 
         cl.pos = "n",
         col = colorRampPalette(c("darkblue", "blue", "white", "red", "darkred"))(100),
         order = "hclust", 
         hclust.method = "average", 
         addrect = 5, #Modules at 70% tree cut height 
         title = "Male Water") 

# Regions in each module at 70% tree cut height
MWa_70 <- as.data.frame(row.names = rownames(MWa_hvk),
  MWa_hvk$cluster_70)
MWa_70 <- MWa_70 %>% rownames_to_column(var="region")
#View(MWa_70)

MWa_per_IMC <- intramodularConnectivity(adjMat = MWa_per_corr,
                                      colors = MWa_hvk$cluster_70) %>% as.data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column(var = "region")

all(rownames(MWa_70$cut_avg_MWa_70) == MWa_per_IMC$region)
MWa_per_IMC <- MWa_per_IMC %>% mutate(Module_ID = MWa_hvk$cluster_70)
View(MWa_per_IMC)
```

### Test - Are outliers driving the large number of strongly positive correlations?
```{r}
#Test with robust correlations (winsorize data)
View(MWa_trans) #Mice are rows, regions are columns

robust_corr <- WRS2::winall(MWa_trans, tr = 0.1) #trims 10% of the most extreme values for each region (2-3)
View(robust_corr$cor)

MWa_hclust_avg_test <- hclust(1 - as.dist(robust_corr$cor), method = 'average')

MWa_hvk_test <- data.frame(cluster_30 = cutree(MWa_hclust_avg_test, h=.30), 
                      cluster_40 = cutree(MWa_hclust_avg_test, h=.40), 
                      cluster_50 = cutree(MWa_hclust_avg_test, h=.50),
                      cluster_60 = cutree(MWa_hclust_avg_test, h=.60),
                      cluster_66 = cutree(MWa_hclust_avg_test, h=.66),
                      cluster_70 = cutree(MWa_hclust_avg_test, h=.70),
                      cluster_75 = cutree(MWa_hclust_avg_test, h=.75),
                      cluster_80 = cutree(MWa_hclust_avg_test, h=.80),
                      cluster_90 = cutree(MWa_hclust_avg_test, h=.90))
View(MWa_hvk_test)

#Let x, y be two brain region
x = runif(15)
y = runif(15)
win_test <- data_frame(x = MWa_trans[,1],
                       x_win = datawizard::winsorize(x, threshold = 0.2),
                       y = MWa_trans[,2],
                       y_win = datawizard::winsorize(y, threshold = 0.2),
                       i = 1:length(x))
#Visualize
ggplot(win_test) +
  geom_point(aes(y = sort(x), x = i )) +
  geom_point(aes(y = sort(x_win), x = i, color = "winsorized")) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14)

data_frame(
  pearson = cor(win_test$x, win_test$y),
  winsored_manual = cor(win_test$x_win, win_test$y_win),
  winsored_correlation = correlation::correlation(win_test[,c("x", "y")], winsorize = 0.1)$r,
  winsored_WRS2 = WRS2::wincor(x,y)$cor
)

#Visualize Winsorized data versus original 
ggplot(win_test) +
  geom_point(aes(x = x, y = y, color = "Original"))+
  geom_smooth(aes(x = x, y = y, color = "Original"), se = F, method='lm') +
  geom_point(aes(x = x_win, y = y_win, color = "Winsorized"))+
  geom_smooth(aes(x = x_win, y = y_win, color = "Winsorized"), se = F, method='lm') +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14)

WRS2::wincor(MWa_trans[,1],MWa_trans[,2], tr = 0.1)$cor 

c <- WRS2::winall(MWa_trans, tr = 0.1)$cor[1,2]

cor(MWa_trans[,1],MWa_trans[,2], method = "pearson")

#Mean absolute change in correlation
mean(abs((MWa_per_corr-robust_corr$cor)))

ggpubr::ggdensity(data_frame(diff =(abs(MWa_per_corr)-abs(robust_corr$cor))[upper.tri(MWa_per_corr)]), x = "diff")

data_frame(diff = (abs(MWa_per_corr)-abs(robust_corr$cor))[upper.tri(MWa_per_corr)]) %>%
  count(abs(diff) > 0.25)

diff = (abs(MWa_per_corr)-abs(robust_corr$cor))
hist(diff[abs(diff) > 0.25], breaks = 100)

hist(rowSums(abs(diff) > 0.5), breaks = 100)

which( rowSums(abs(diff) > 0.25) > 100 ) #When data was winsorized, 13 regions have correlations changed >0.25 R with at least 100 other regions
which( rowSums(abs(diff) > 0.5) > 26)

corrplot(robust_corr$cor, 
         type = "full", 
         tl.pos = "n",
         method = "color", 
         cl.pos = "n",
         col = colorRampPalette(c("darkblue", "blue", "white", "red", "darkred"))(100),
         order = "hclust", 
         hclust.method = "average", 
         addrect = 5, #Modules at 70% tree cut height 
         title = "Winsorized Male Water")

#Test with eliminating high and low mice
MWa_trans <- as.data.frame(MWa_trans) %>% mutate(cFos_Sum = rowSums(MWa_trans))
View(MWa_trans)

test <- MWa_trans[-4,]
test = select(test, -427)
test <- test[-5,]
View(test)

MWa_per_corr_test <- cor(test, method = "pearson")
View(MWa_per_corr_test)

MWa_hclust_avg_test <- hclust(1 - as.dist(MWa_per_corr_test), method = 'average')

MWa_hvk_test <- data.frame(cluster_30 = cutree(MWa_hclust_avg_test, h=.30), 
                      cluster_40 = cutree(MWa_hclust_avg_test, h=.40), 
                      cluster_50 = cutree(MWa_hclust_avg_test, h=.50),
                      cluster_60 = cutree(MWa_hclust_avg_test, h=.60),
                      cluster_66 = cutree(MWa_hclust_avg_test, h=.66),
                      cluster_70 = cutree(MWa_hclust_avg_test, h=.70),
                      cluster_75 = cutree(MWa_hclust_avg_test, h=.75),
                      cluster_80 = cutree(MWa_hclust_avg_test, h=.80),
                      cluster_90 = cutree(MWa_hclust_avg_test, h=.90))
View(MWa_hvk_test)

corrplot(MWa_per_corr_test, 
         type = "full", 
         tl.pos = "n",
         method = "color", 
         cl.pos = "n",
         col = colorRampPalette(c("darkblue", "blue", "white", "red", "darkred"))(100),
         order = "hclust", 
         hclust.method = "average", 
         addrect = 7, #Modules at 70% tree cut height 
         title = "Male Water")
```

## Module overlap with functional networks
```{r}
#Binge/Intoxication
# Male Water
MWa_binge_num <- sapply(MWa_mod_regions, 
                       function(x) length(intersect(binge, x))) 
View(MWa_binge_num) #All binge-related regions are in module 1

MWa_binge_overlap <- sapply(MWa_mod_regions, function(x) fisher.test(MWa_per_IMC$region %in% x,
                                          MWa_per_IMC$region %in% binge,  
                                           alternative = "g")$p.value) 
View(MWa_binge_overlap) 

MWa_binge_overlap_fdr <- as.data.frame(MWa_binge_overlap) %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), function(x) p.adjust(x, method = "fdr")))
View(MWa_binge_overlap_fdr)

#Female Water
FWa_binge_num <- sapply(FWa_mod_regions, 
                       function(x) length(intersect(binge, x))) 
View(FWa_binge_num)

FWa_binge_overlap <- sapply(FWa_mod_regions, function(x) fisher.test(FWa_per_IMC$region %in% x,
                                          FWa_per_IMC$region %in% binge,  
                                           alternative = "g")$p.value) 
View(FWa_binge_overlap) 

FWa_binge_overlap_fdr <- as.data.frame(FWa_binge_overlap) %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), function(x) p.adjust(x, method = "fdr")))
View(FWa_binge_overlap_fdr) #Module 2 significantly overlaps with binge 

#Male Ethanol
MEt_binge_num <- sapply(MEt_mod_regions, 
                       function(x) length(intersect(binge, x))) 
View(MEt_binge_num)

MEt_binge_overlap <- sapply(MEt_mod_regions, function(x) fisher.test(MEt_per_IMC$region %in% x,
                                          MEt_per_IMC$region %in% binge,  
                                           alternative = "g")$p.value) 
View(MEt_binge_overlap) 

MEt_binge_overlap_fdr <- as.data.frame(MEt_binge_overlap) %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), function(x) p.adjust(x, method = "fdr")))
View(MEt_binge_overlap_fdr) #Modules 4 and 8 significantly overlaps with binge 

#Female Ethanol
FEt_binge_num <- sapply(FEt_mod_regions, 
                       function(x) length(intersect(binge, x))) 
View(FEt_binge_num)

FEt_binge_overlap <- sapply(FEt_mod_regions, function(x) fisher.test(FEt_per_IMC$region %in% x,
                                          FEt_per_IMC$region %in% binge,  
                                           alternative = "g")$p.value) 
View(FEt_binge_overlap) #No modules significantly overlaps with binge 

#Witdrawal/Negative affect
# Male Water
MWa_withdrawal_num <- sapply(MWa_mod_regions, 
                       function(x) length(intersect(withdrawal, x))) 
View(MWa_withdrawal_num) #All withdrawal-related regions are in module 1

MWa_withdrawal_overlap <- sapply(MWa_mod_regions, function(x) fisher.test(MWa_per_IMC$region %in% x,
                                          MWa_per_IMC$region %in% withdrawal,  
                                           alternative = "g")$p.value) 
View(MWa_withdrawal_overlap) #no significant overlap 

# Female Water
FWa_withdrawal_num <- sapply(FWa_mod_regions, 
                       function(x) length(intersect(withdrawal, x))) 
View(FWa_withdrawal_num) 

FWa_withdrawal_overlap <- sapply(FWa_mod_regions, function(x) fisher.test(FWa_per_IMC$region %in% x,
                                          FWa_per_IMC$region %in% withdrawal,  
                                           alternative = "g")$p.value) 
View(FWa_withdrawal_overlap) #Modules 3 + 4 significant

FWa_withdrawal_overlap_fdr <- as.data.frame(FWa_withdrawal_overlap) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), function(x) p.adjust(x, method = "fdr")))
View(FWa_withdrawal_overlap_fdr) #No modules survive multiple comparisons correction

# Male Ethanol

                       function(x) length(intersect(withdrawal, x)))

MEt_withdrawal_overlap <- sapply(MEt_mod_regions, function(x) fisher.test(MEt_per_IMC$region %in% x,
                                          MEt_per_IMC$region %in% withdrawal,
```

## Supplemental Figure S10C, Intramodular Correlation
### Male Water
```{r}
rownames(MWa_per_corr) %in% MWa_per_IMC$region
MWa_per_IMC <- MWa_per_IMC %>% arrange(Module_ID)
MWa_corr <- MWa_per_corr
diag(MWa_corr) <-0
MWa_corr[MWa_corr == 0] <- NA

MWa_mods_corr <- lapply(MWa_mod_regions, function(rows) {
  MWa_corr[rows, rows, drop = FALSE]
}) 
View(MWa_mods_corr) #Makes a matrix for each module separately

MWa_row_means <- lapply(MWa_mods_corr, function(mat) {
  rowMeans(mat, na.rm=TRUE)
}) 
View(MWa_row_means) #Calculates row Means for every module

Avg_cor <- unlist(MWa_row_means)
View(Avg_cor)

MWa_mod_Avg_corr <- data.frame(Avg_Cor = Avg_cor,
                               Module = MWa_per_IMC$Module_ID, 
                               Region = MWa_per_IMC$region) #Make sure this df is in ascending module order
View(MWa_mod_Avg_corr)

base_plot <- ggbetweenstats(MWa_mod_Avg_corr, x="Module", y="Avg_Cor",
               pairwise.display = "none",
                            pairwise.comparisons = "TRUE",
                            xlab = "Modules",
                            ylab = "Average Correlation Coefficient",
               title = "Male Water Correlations per Module") + 
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-0.17, 1.1), 
    breaks = seq(from = 0, to = 1, by = .25))

# using `pairwise_comparisons()` function from ggstatsplot to create a data frame with results
tmp3 <- pairwise_comparisons(MWa_mod_Avg_corr, x="Module", y="Avg_Cor") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(groups = purrr::pmap(.l = list(group1, group2), .f = c)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(group1) %>%
mutate(asterisk_label = case_when(p.value > 0.05 ~ "ns",
                                  p.value <= 0.05 & p.value >0.01 ~ "*",
                                 p.value <= 0.01 & p.value >0.001 ~ "**", 
                                 p.value <= 0.001 & p.value >0.0001 ~"***", 
                                 p.value <= 0.00001 ~ "****")) #p.value is the Holm adjusted p-value
View(tmp3)
tmp4 <- tmp3 %>% filter(p.value < 0.05) #remove non-significant comparison so it doesn't show on plot
View(tmp4)

tmp_mod_plot4 <- base_plot +  ggsignif::geom_signif(
    comparisons = tmp4$groups,
    map_signif_level = TRUE,
    annotations = tmp4$asterisk_label,
    y_position = c(0.79, 0.87),
    test = NULL, 
    tip_length = 0)

tmp_mod_plot4

ggsave("MH2O_mod_plot.svg",
       width = 6, 
       height = 4, 
       units = "in")
```

```{r}
                            xlab = "Modules",
                            ylab = "Average Correlation Coefficient",
               title = "Female Ethanol Correlations per Module") + 
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1.1), 
    breaks = seq(from = 0, to = 1, by = .25))

# using `pairwise_comparisons()` function from ggstatsplot to create a data frame with results
tmp3 <- pairwise_comparisons(FEt_mod_Avg_corr, x="Module", y="Avg_Cor") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(groups = purrr::pmap(.l = list(group1, group2), .f = c)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(group1) %>%
mutate(asterisk_label = case_when(p.value > 0.05 ~ "ns",
                                  p.value <= 0.05 & p.value >0.01 ~ "*",
                                 p.value <= 0.01 & p.value >0.001 ~ "**", 
                                 p.value <= 0.001 & p.value >0.0001 ~"***", 
                                 p.value <= 0.00001 ~ "****"))
View(tmp3)
tmp4 <- tmp3 %>% filter(p.value < 0.05) #remove non-significant comparison so it doesn't show on plot
View(tmp4)

tmp_mod_plot2 <- base_plot +  ggsignif::geom_signif(
    comparisons = tmp4$groups,
    map_signif_level = TRUE,
    annotations = tmp4$asterisk_label,
    y_position = c(.65, .75, .85),
    test = NULL,
    na.rm = TRUE, 
    tip_length = 0)

tmp_mod_plot2

ggsave("FEtOH_mod_plot.svg",
       width = 6, 
       height = 4, 
       units = "in")
```

## Supplemental Figure S10D, Supplemental Table S6-9, Type of hub and nodes, Supplemental Tables S10-13 Hubs 
### Male Water
```{r}
MWa_per_IMC <- MWa_per_IMC %>% mutate(Participation = (1-(MWa_per_IMC$kWithin/MWa_per_IMC$kTotal))) #Participation is a ratio of how connected a node is to others in its module, versus to the network as a whole

MWa_per_hubs <- MWa_per_IMC %>% group_by(Module_ID) %>% slice_max(kWithin, prop = 0.2)
View(MWa_per_hubs) 

MWa_per_hubs <- MWa_per_hubs %>% mutate(Type = case_when(
    Participation <= 0.3 ~ "Provincial",
    Participation> 0.3 & Participation <= 0.75 ~ "Connector",
    Participation > 0.75 ~ "Kinless"))

MWa_per_nodes <- MWa_per_IMC %>% filter(!(region %in% MWa_per_hubs$region))
View(MWa_per_nodes)

MWa_per_nodes <- MWa_per_nodes %>%mutate(Type = case_when(
    Participation <= 0.05 ~ "Ultra Peripheral",
    Participation > 0.05 & Participation <= 0.62 ~ "Peripheral",
    Participation > 0.62 & Participation <= 0.8 ~ "Non-hub Connector",
    Participation > 0.8 ~ "Non-hub Kinless"))

MWa_per_all <- rbind(MWa_per_nodes, MWa_per_hubs)
View(MWa_per_all)

MWa_table <- MWa_per_all %>%
        group_by(Type) %>%
        tally()
View(MWa_table)

svglite::svglite("MWa_pie.svg",
                width = 6,
                height = 4)

pie(MWa_table$n, labels = paste(MWa_table$Type, MWa_table$n, sep=" -"),
   main="Male Water Node Types", 
   col = c("#FC8D62", "#E78AC3","#A6D854", "#FFD92F", "#E5C494"), 
   cex =.8)

dev.off()
```

```{r}
  MWa_corr[rows, rows, drop = FALSE]
}) 
View(MWa_anat_corr) 

MWa_anat_row_means <- lapply(MWa_anat_corr, function(mat) {
  rowMeans(mat, na.rm=TRUE)
})

MWa_Anat <- unlist(MWa_anat_row_means)
View(MWa_Anat)

#Female water

  FWa_corr[rows, rows, drop = FALSE]
})

FWa_anat_row_means <- lapply(FWa_anat_corr, function(mat) {

  MEt_corr[rows, rows, drop = FALSE]
})
```

### S11A Cortical Plate
```{r}
cortical_plate <- Avg_Corr_Anat %>% filter(Anat_Group == "Cortical Plate") #filters rows by Cortical plate
View(cortical_plate)

base_plot <- ggbetweenstats(cortical_plate, x="names", y="Avg_Corr",
                            pairwise.display = "none",
                            pairwise.comparisons = "TRUE",
                            xlab = "Sex & Fluid Group",
                            ylab = "Average Correlation Coefficient",
                            title = "Average Correlation Coefficients in Cortical Plate") +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-0.17, 1.1), 
    breaks = seq(from = 0, to = 1, by = .25)) +
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = c("#C87A8A", "#9189C7","#909646", "#00A396")) #each dot is the average corr coefficient for a region within the cortical plate

# using `pairwise_comparisons()` function to create a data frame with results
tmp3 <- pairwise_comparisons(cortical_plate, x="names", y="Avg_Corr") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(groups = purrr::pmap(.l = list(group1, group2), .f = c)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(group1) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(asterisk_label = case_when(p.value > 0.05 ~ "ns",
                                  p.value <= 0.05 & p.value >0.01 ~ "*",
                                 p.value <= 0.01 & p.value >0.001 ~ "**", 
                                 p.value <= 0.001 & p.value >0.0001 ~"***", 
                                 p.value <= 0.00001 ~ "****"))
View(tmp3)
tmp4 <- tmp3 %>% filter(p.value < 0.05) #remove non-significant comparison so it doesn't show on plot
View(tmp4)

base_plot +  ggsignif::geom_signif(
    comparisons = tmp4$groups,
    map_signif_level = TRUE,
    annotations = tmp4$asterisk_label,
    y_position = c(0.8, 0.9, 1),
    test = NULL,
    na.rm = TRUE, 
    tip_length = 0)

ggsave("cortical plate.svg",
       width = 6, 
       height = 4, 
       units = "in")
```

### S11I Average Correlation per largest module 
```{r}
MEt_mod_Avg_corr <- MEt_mod_Avg_corr %>% mutate(Module = paste0("MEt", "_", Module))
FEt_mod_Avg_corr <- FEt_mod_Avg_corr %>% mutate(Module = paste0("FEt", "_", Module))
MWa_mod_Avg_corr <- MWa_mod_Avg_corr %>% mutate(Module = paste0("MWa", "_", Module))
FWa_mod_Avg_corr <- FWa_mod_Avg_corr %>% mutate(Module = paste0("FWa", "_", Module))

All_Avg_Corr <- rbind(MEt_mod_Avg_corr, FEt_mod_Avg_corr, MWa_mod_Avg_corr, FWa_mod_Avg_corr)
View(All_Avg_Corr) #Average intramodular correlation values for all networks

large_mods <- All_Avg_Corr %>% filter(Module %in% c("MEt_1", "FEt_1", "MWa_1", "FWa_2"))
large_mods$Module <- recode(large_mods$Module, "MEt_1" = 'M_EtOH',
                      "FEt_1" = 'F_EtOH',
                      "MWa_1" = 'M_H2O', 
                      "FWa_2" = 'F_H2O')
View(large_mods)

# converting to factor
large_mods$Module <- as.factor(large_mods$Module)

base_plot <- ggbetweenstats(large_mods, x="Module", y="Avg_Cor", 
                            pairwise.display = "none",
                            pairwise.comparisons = "TRUE",
                            xlab = "Sex & Fluid Group",
                            ylab = "Average Correlation Coefficient",
                            title = "Average Correlation Coefficients in Largest Module") +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-0.17, 1.1), 
    breaks = seq(from = 0, to = 1, by = .25))

# using `pairwise_comparisons()` function to create a data frame with results
tmp3 <- pairwise_comparisons(large_mods, x="Module", y="Avg_Cor") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(groups = purrr::pmap(.l = list(group1, group2), .f = c)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(group1) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(asterisk_label = case_when(p.value > 0.05 ~ "ns",
                                  p.value <= 0.05 & p.value >0.01 ~ "*",
                                 p.value <= 0.01 & p.value >0.001 ~ "**", 
                                 p.value <= 0.001 & p.value >0.0001 ~"***", 
                                 p.value <= 0.00001 ~ "****"))
View(tmp3)
tmp4 <- tmp3 %>% filter(p.value < 0.05) #remove non-significant comparison so it doesn't show on plot
View(tmp4)

base_plot +  ggsignif::geom_signif(
    comparisons = tmp4$groups,
    map_signif_level = TRUE,
    annotations = tmp4$asterisk_label,
    y_position = c(0.65, 0.75, .85, .95, 1.05),
    test = NULL,
    na.rm = TRUE, 
    tip_length = 0) +
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = c("#C87A8A", "#9189C7","#909646", "#00A396"))

ggsave("largest_module.svg",
       width = 6, 
       height = 4, 
       units = "in")
```

## Supplemental Tables S10-13, Overrepresentation Analysis
### Anatomical Category Overrepresentation 
```{r}
# Male Water
MWa_Anat_Mod <- sapply(MWa_mod_regions, 
                       function(module) { sapply(Regions_Anatomy, 
                                                   function(region) fisher.test(MWa_per_IMC$region %in% region,
                                          MWa_per_IMC$region %in% module,
                                          alternative = "g")$p.value) }) 
View(MWa_Anat_Mod) #nested functions - for each module asks in any anatomical category is over represented
MWa_Anat_Mod_fdr <- as.data.frame(MWa_Anat_Mod) %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), function(x) p.adjust(x, method = "fdr")))
View(MWa_Anat_Mod_fdr)

# Female Water
FWa_Anat_Mod <- sapply(FWa_mod_regions, 
                       function(module) { sapply(Regions_Anatomy, 
                                                   function(region) fisher.test(FWa_per_IMC$region %in% region,
                                          FWa_per_IMC$region %in% module,
                                          alternative = "g")$p.value) })

FWa_Anat_Mod_fdr <- as.data.frame(FWa_Anat_Mod) %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), function(x) p.adjust(x, method = "fdr")))
```

```{r}
# Female Ethanol
FEt_mod_overlap <- sapply(FEt_mod_regions, function(x) fisher.test(FEt_per_IMC$region %in% x,
                                          FEt_per_IMC$region %in% diff_cFos$region,  
                                           alternative = "g")$p.value) 
View(FEt_mod_overlap)

FEt_mod_overlap_fdr <- as.data.frame(FEt_mod_overlap) %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), function(x) p.adjust(x, method = "fdr")))
View(FEt_mod_overlap_fdr)
```

# Network Analysis: Method 2 - WRCNA
## Data pre-processing
```{r}
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

cFos_sqrt <- cFos_397_redux_SQRT
cFos_sqrt <- t(cFos_sqrt)
View(cFos_sqrt) #Each region is a column and each mouse is a row

gsg = goodSamplesGenes(cFos_sqrt, verbose = 3) #checks if any samples have too many missing values
gsg$allOK

#Cluster samples to see if there are any obvious outliers
sampleTree = hclust(dist(cFos_sqrt), method = "average")

# Plot the sample tree: Open a graphic output window of size 12 by 9 inches
sizeGrWindow(12,9)

par(cex = 0.6);
par(mar = c(0,4,2,0))
plot(sampleTree, main = "Sample clustering to detect outliers", sub="", xlab="", cex.lab = 1.5,
cex.axis = 1.5, cex.main = 2)

#Sample 44 may be an outlier, remove from further analysis
abline(h=800, col = "red")

clust = cutreeStatic(sampleTree, cutHeight = 700, minSize = 10)
table(clust)
# clust 1 contains the samples we want to keep.
keepSamples = (clust==1)
cFos_sqrt1 = cFos_sqrt[keepSamples, ]
nGenes = ncol(cFos_sqrt1)
nSamples = nrow(cFos_sqrt1)
View(cFos_sqrt1)
```

## Figure 5A, Network Construction and Module Detection
```{r}
# Choose a set of soft-thresholding powers
powers = c(c(1:10), seq(from = 12, to=20, by=2))

# Call the network topology analysis function
sft = pickSoftThreshold(cFos_sqrt1, powerVector = powers, verbose = 5)
View(sft)

# Plot the results:
sizeGrWindow(9, 5)
par(mfrow = c(1,2))
cex1 = 0.9

# Scale-free topology fit index as a function of the soft-thresholding power
plot(sft$fitIndices[,1], -sign(sft$fitIndices[,3])*sft$fitIndices[,2],
     xlab="Soft Threshold (power)",
     ylab="Scale Free Topology Model Fit,signed R^2",
     type="n",
     main = paste("Scale independence"))
text(sft$fitIndices[,1], -sign(sft$fitIndices[,3])*sft$fitIndices[,2],
labels=powers,cex=cex1,col="red");
# this line corresponds to using an R^2 cut-off of h
abline(h=0.80,col="pink")

# Mean connectivity as a function of the soft-thresholding power
plot(sft$fitIndices[,1], sft$fitIndices[,5],
     xlab="Soft Threshold (power)",
     ylab="Mean Connectivity", 
     type="n",
     main = paste("Mean connectivity"))
text(sft$fitIndices[,1], sft$fitIndices[,5], labels=powers, cex=cex1,col="red")
#Selected Soft threshold power = 8

net = blockwiseModules(cFos_sqrt1, 
                       power = 8,
                       networkType = "unsigned",
                       TOMType = "unsigned", 
                       minModuleSize = 10, 
                       reassignThreshold = 0, 
                       mergeCutHeight = 0.15, 
                       numericLabels = TRUE, 
                       pamRespectsDendro = FALSE, 
                       pamStage = TRUE,
                       deepSplit = 2,
                       saveTOMs = TRUE,
                       saveTOMFileBase = "cFos_all",
                       verbose = 3)

# Plot the dendrogram and the module colors underneath
mergedColors = labels2colors(net$colors)

svglite::svglite("WGCNA_dendro.svg",
                width = 6,
                height = 4)

plotDendroAndColors(net$dendrograms[[1]], 
                    cbind(mergedColors),
                    "Module colors",
                    dendroLabels = FALSE, 
                    hang = 0.03,
                    addGuide = TRUE, 
                    guideHang = 0.05, 
                    main = "Overall Cluster Dendrogram")

dev.off()

moduleLabels = net$colors
moduleColors = labels2colors(net$colors)
MEs = net$MEs
geneTree = net$dendrograms[[1]]

adjacency = adjacency(cFos_sqrt1, power = 8) #same soft power used in constructing the network
View(adjacency)
adjacency[adjacency == 0] <- NA

Overall_IMC <- intramodularConnectivity(adjMat = adjacency,
                                  colors = net$colors) %>% as.data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column(var = "region")
Overall_IMC$module = labels2colors(net$colors)
View(Overall_IMC)
```

```{r}
  arrange(Allen_Group_Name)
View(MBlue)

my_colors <- c("#B6F760", "#B6F760", "#B6F760", "#E8D158", "#E8D158", "#E8D158", "#E8D158", "#EB873D", "#C14020", "#70190E", "#70190E", "#70190E", "#70190E")
names(my_colors) <- c("LHA-L", "PST-L", "ZI-L", "APN-L", "MRN-L", "RR-L",  "RN-L", "TRS-L", "LSX-L", "CL-L",  "LH-L",  "PF-L","VM-R") #Colors correspond to anatomical category

MWa_MBlue <- MWa_graph[Info_MBlue, Info_MBlue]
View(MWa_MBlue)

reorder_columns <- match(MBlue$acronym, colnames(MWa_MBlue))
reorder_rows <- match(MBlue$acronym, rownames(MWa_MBlue))
MWa_MBlue <- MWa_MBlue[reorder_rows, reorder_columns]

MWa_MBlue <- as.data.frame(MWa_MBlue) %>% rename("APN-L*" = "APN-L", 
                                              "MRN-L*" ="MRN-L", 
                                              "RR-L*^" ="RR-L",  
                                              "RN-L*" = "RN-L", 
                                              "TRS-L*" ="TRS-L",
                                              "CL-L*" ="CL-L",
                                              "PF-L*" ="PF-L",
                                              "VM-R*" = "VM-R") #*denotes regions with diff c-Fos expression, ^denotes diff c-Fos+GFP

MWa_MBlue <- as.matrix(MWa_MBlue)

MWa_MBlue_graph <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(
  as.matrix(MWa_MBlue),
  mode = "undirected",
  weighted = T,
  diag = T) #True since diagonal is already 0

tmp_size <- rowSums(MWa_MBlue) 
tmp_size <- tmp_size / max(tmp_size)

as_tbl_graph(MWa_MBlue_graph) %>%
   ggraph('igraph', layout = layout.circle(MWa_MBlue_graph), circular = TRUE) +
  geom_edge_arc(lineend = "round",
                 aes(edge_width = weight,
                     edge_alpha = weight)) +
  scale_edge_color_grey(start=0,
                        end=1)+
   geom_node_text(aes(label = name), 
                  repel = T,
                 check_overlap = T,
                  size = 4) +
  geom_node_point(size = ((tmp_size-min(tmp_size)/2)*10), 
                  fill = my_colors, shape = 21, color = my_colors, stroke = 1) +
  labs(title = "Male Water Midnight Blue Module") +
  theme_graph(background = "white") +
  scale_edge_width(limits = c(0,1), 
                   range = c(0.5, 6)) +
  scale_edge_alpha(limits = c(0,1), 
                   range = c(0.1,1))

ggsave("MWa_graph_4NOV.svg",
       width = 6, 
       height = 4, 
       units = "in")
```

```{r}
MWa_IMC <- intramodularConnectivity(adjMat = MWa_graph,
                                  colors = net$colors) %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "region")
MWa_IMC$module = labels2colors(net$colors)
View(MWa_IMC)
MWa_IMC <- MWa_IMC %>% mutate(Participation = (1-(MWa_IMC$kWithin/MWa_IMC$kTotal)))
mean(MWa_IMC$Participation)
```

```{r}
Mod_regions <- split(Overall_IMC$region, Overall_IMC$module) #Creates list of region names in each module

Anat_Mod_num <- sapply(Mod_regions, 
                       function(module) { sapply(Regions_Anatomy, 
                                                   function(region) length(intersect(region, module))) }) 
View(Anat_Mod_num)

plot_Anat_num <- as.data.frame(Anat_Mod_num) %>% t() 
plot_Anat_num <- (plot_Anat_num/rowSums(plot_Anat_num)) %>% t()
plot_Anat_num <- as.data.frame(plot_Anat_num) %>% rownames_to_column("Category")
plot_Anat_num <- plot_Anat_num %>% pivot_longer(cols=c(2:18), 
                                  names_to = "Module",
                                  values_to = "Proportion") 
View(plot_Anat_num)

x<-plot_Anat_num$Module

ggplot(plot_Anat_num, aes(x=Module, y=Proportion, fill=Category))+
  geom_bar(width = .9, stat = "identity") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels=as.character(x), breaks=x) + 
  scale_fill_viridis(discrete = TRUE, option = "H", aesthetics = "fill") +
  labs(title = "WGCNA Overall Modules") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45, vjust=1, hjust=1))

       width = 6, 
       height = 4, 
       units = "in")
```

## Supplemental Figure S12C Intramodular Adjacency Values
```{r}
rownames(adjacency) %in% Overall_IMC$region
Overall_IMC <- Overall_IMC %>% arrange(module)

adj1 <- adjacency
adj1[adj1 == 0] <- NA
View(adj1)

Mod_regions <- split(Overall_IMC$region, Overall_IMC$module) #Creates list of region names in each module 
View(Mod_regions)

Overall_adj <- sapply(Mod_regions, function(rows) {
  adj1[rows, rows, drop = FALSE]
}) 
View(Overall_adj) #Makes a matrix for each module separately

Mod_means <- lapply(Overall_adj, function(mat) {
  rowMeans(mat, na.rm=TRUE)
}) 
View(Mod_means) #Calculates row Means for every module

Avg_cor <- unlist(Mod_means)
View(Avg_cor)

Mod_Avg_corr <- data.frame(Avg_Cor = Avg_cor,
                               Module = Overall_IMC$module, 
                               Region = Overall_IMC$region) #Make sure this df is in ascending module order
View(Mod_Avg_corr)

base_plot <- ggbetweenstats(Mod_Avg_corr, x="Module", y="Avg_Cor",
                            pairwise.display = "none",
                            pairwise.comparisons = "TRUE",
                            xlab = "Modules",
                            ylab = "Average Adjacency Value",
                            title = "Adjacency Values per Module") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-0., 0.2), 
    breaks = seq(from = 0, to = 0.2, by = .05))   

# using `pairwise_comparisons()` function from ggstatsplot to create a data frame with results
tmp3 <- pairwise_comparisons(Mod_Avg_corr, x="Module", y="Avg_Cor") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(groups = purrr::pmap(.l = list(group1, group2), .f = c)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(group1) %>%
mutate(asterisk_label = case_when(p.value > 0.05 ~ "ns",
                                  p.value <= 0.05 & p.value >0.01 ~ "*",
                                 p.value <= 0.01 & p.value >0.001 ~ "**", 
                                 p.value <= 0.001 & p.value >0.0001 ~"***", 
                                 p.value <= 0.00001 ~ "****"))
View(tmp3)
tmp3[is.na(tmp3)] <- "***"
tmp4 <- tmp3 %>% filter(p.value < 0.05) #remove non-significant comparison so it doesn't show on plot
View(tmp4)

base_plot +
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = c("black","blue","brown","cyan","green", "greenyellow","grey", "lightcyan","magenta", "midnightblue","pink","purple","red","salmon","tan","turquoise","yellow"))

ggsave("WGCNA_IMC.svg",
       width = 6, 
       height = 4, 
       units = "in")
```

## Supplemental Figure S12D, Supplemental Table S17 Type of Node and Hub, Supplemental Tables S16 Hubs
```{r}
Overall_IMC <- Overall_IMC %>% mutate(Participation = (1-(Overall_IMC$kWithin/Overall_IMC$kTotal))) 
View(Overall_IMC)

Overall_hubs <- Overall_IMC %>% group_by(module) %>% slice_max(kWithin, prop = 0.2) 
View(Overall_hubs)

Overall_hubs <- Overall_hubs %>% mutate(Type = case_when(
    Participation <= 0.3 ~ "Provincial",
    Participation> 0.3 & Participation <= 0.75 ~ "Connector",
    Participation > 0.75 ~ "Kinless"))

Overall_nodes <- Overall_IMC %>% filter(!(region %in% Overall_hubs$region))
View(Overall_nodes)

Overall_nodes <- Overall_nodes %>%mutate(Type = case_when(
    Participation <= 0.05 ~ "Ultra Peripheral",
    Participation > 0.05 & Participation <= 0.62 ~ "Peripheral",
    Participation > 0.62 & Participation <= 0.8 ~ "Non-hub Connector",
    Participation > 0.8 ~ "Non-hub Kinless"))

Overall_all <- rbind(Overall_nodes, Overall_hubs)
View(Overall_all)

table <- Overall_all %>%
        group_by(Type) %>%
        tally()

svglite::svglite("WGCNA_node_types.svg",
                width = 6,
                height = 4)

pie(table$n, labels = paste(table$Type, table$n, sep=" -"),
   main="WGCNA Node Types", 
   col = brewer.pal(n = 7, name = "Set2"))
# legend("bottomright", table$Type, cex = 1,  
# fill = c("#66C2A5", "#FC8D62", "#8DA0CB", "#E78AC3", "#A6D854", "#FFD92F", "#E5C494")) 

dev.off()
```

```{r}
                     edge_alpha = weight)) +
  scale_edge_color_grey(start=0,
                        end=1)+
  geom_node_point(size = ((tmp_size-min(tmp_size)/2)*10), 
                  fill = black_colors, shape = 21, color = black_colors, stroke = 1) +
  geom_node_text(aes(label = name), 
                  repel = T,
                  check_overlap = T,
                  size = 4,
                  colour="black") +
  labs(title = "Female Water Black Module") +
  theme_graph(background = "white") +
  scale_edge_width(limits = c(0,1), 
                   range = c(0.5, 6)) +
  scale_edge_alpha(limits = c(0,1), 
                   range = c(0.1,1))

ggsave("FWa_Black_graph.svg",
       width = 6, 
       height = 4, 
       units = "in")
```

### Male Ethanol
```{r}
View(MEt_graph)
```

## Supplemental Tables S17, Overrepresentation Analysis
```{r}
# Anatomical Category 
Anat_Mod_overrep <- sapply(Mod_regions, 
                       function(module) { sapply(Regions_Anatomy, 
                                                   function(region) fisher.test(Overall_IMC$region %in% region,
                                          Overall_IMC$region %in% module,
                                          alternative = "g")$p.value) }) 
View(Anat_Mod_overrep) 

Anat_Mod_overrep_fdr <- as.data.frame(Anat_Mod_overrep) %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), function(x) p.adjust(x, method = "fdr")))
View(Anat_Mod_overrep_fdr)

# Hemisphere
Hemi_Mod <- sapply(Mod_regions, 
                       function(module) { sapply(Regions_Hemi, 
                                                   function(region) fisher.test(Overall_IMC$region %in% region,
                                          Overall_IMC$region %in% module,
                                          alternative = "g")$p.value) }) 
View(Hemi_Mod)

Hemi_Mod_fdr <- as.data.frame(Hemi_Mod) %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), function(x) p.adjust(x, method = "fdr")))
View(Hemi_Mod_fdr)

# Differential c-Fos region Overrepresentation 
Mod_overlap <- sapply(Mod_regions, function(x) fisher.test(Overall_IMC$region %in% x,
                                          Overall_IMC$region %in% diff_cFos$region,  
                                           alternative = "g")$p.value) 
View(Mod_overlap) 

Mod_overlap_fdr <- as.data.frame(Mod_overlap) %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), function(x) p.adjust(x, method = "fdr")))
View(Mod_overlap_fdr)

#Number of regions with differential c-Fos expression in each modules
cFos_Mod_num <- sapply(Mod_regions, 
                       function(x) length(intersect(diff_cFos$region, x)) ) 
View(cFos_Mod_num)

# Differential c-Fos region Overrepresentation 
Mod_overlap1 <- sapply(Mod_regions, function(x) fisher.test(Overall_IMC$region %in% x,
                                          Overall_IMC$region %in% diff_cFos_GFP$region,  
                                           alternative = "g")$p.value) 
View(Mod_overlap1) 

Mod_overlap1_fdr <- as.data.frame(Mod_overlap1) %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), function(x) p.adjust(x, method = "fdr")))
View(Mod_overlap1_fdr) #red module has significant overlap with regions that have differential c-Fos+GFP coexpression

#Number of regions with differential c-Fos+GFP co-expression in each modules
cFosgfp_Mod_num <- sapply(Mod_regions, 
                       function(x) length(intersect(diff_cFos_GFP$region, x)) ) 
View(cFosgfp_Mod_num) #8 diff c-Fos+GFP regions in the red module
```

### Node and hubs types differ between sex and fluid groups
```{r}
# Male
MWa_table <- MWa_table %>% add_row(Type = "Connector", n = 0)%>%
  add_row(Type = "Non-hub Connector", n= 0)
MWa_table <- with(MWa_table,  MWa_table[order(Type) , ])

MEt_MWa_nodes <- data.frame(row.names = MEt_table$Type,
                            Ethanol = MEt_table$n,
                            Water = MWa_table$n)
chisq.test(MEt_MWa_nodes)

#Female 
FEt_FWa_nodes <- data.frame(row.names = FEt_table$Type,
                            Ethanol = FEt_table$n,
                            Water = FWa_table$n)
chisq.test(FEt_FWa_nodes)

#Ethanol
MEt_FEt_nodes <- data.frame(row.names = MEt_table$Type,
                            Male = MEt_table$n,
                            Female = FEt_table$n)
chisq.test(MEt_FEt_nodes) 

#Water
MWa_FWa_nodes <- data.frame(row.names = MWa_table$Type,
                            Male = MWa_table$n,
                            Female = FWa_table$n)
chisq.test(MWa_FWa_nodes)

p.adjust(c(2.2e-16, 1.445e-06, 3.374e-12, 2.2e-16), method = "fdr") 
```

### Anti-correlation quantification
```{r}
pos_neg_ct <- data.frame(M_EtOH = signcount(MEt_per_corr),
                         F_EtOH = signcount(FEt_per_corr),
                         M_H2O = signcount(MWa_per_corr),
                         F_H2O = signcount(FWa_per_corr))
pos_neg_ct <- pos_neg_ct[-c(2),]
View(pos_neg_ct)

# Male
M_cts <- data.frame( M_EtOH = pos_neg_ct$M_EtOH, 
                     M_H2O = pos_neg_ct$M_H2O)
fisher.test(M_cts) 

# Female 
F_cts <- data.frame( F_EtOH = pos_neg_ct$F_EtOH, 
                     F_H2O = pos_neg_ct$F_H2O)
fisher.test(F_cts) 

# Water
H2O_cts <- data.frame( M_H2O = pos_neg_ct$M_H2O, 
                     F_H2O = pos_neg_ct$F_H2O)
fisher.test(H2O_cts) 

#Ethanol 
EtOH_cts <- data.frame( F_EtOH = pos_neg_ct$F_EtOH, 
                     M_EtOH = pos_neg_ct$M_EtOH)
fisher.test(EtOH_cts) 

#Proportions of positive to negative correlations
pos_neg_ct <- t(pos_neg_ct)
pos_neg_ct <- as.data.frame(pos_neg_ct) %>% mutate(proportion_neg_pos = (neg/pos))
View(pos_neg_ct)
```
